en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a European riverside town nestled between wooded hills. In the center stands a prominent historic building with a tall clock or bell tower, surrounded by dense roofs of traditional houses. A multi‑arched stone bridge crosses the river to the right. The image is framed by foliage in the foreground, and cursive writing appears at the bottom margin.
